## Supervisor v0.6.0

### Student timetables
- **Add a timetable:** click the new calendar icon at the top of a student's details, then click or drag over the hours they are busy. There is one for each semester, and just the times, with no module names. Lectures start at quarter past and finish on the hour, so the grid does too.
- **Clash warnings:** when you choose a date and time for a meeting, a warning shows if the student is busy then. A meeting is taken to last an hour, so one at 14:00 clashes with a lecture at 14:15. Repeating meetings are checked week by week, and with only a date chosen you see when the student is busy that day.
- **Meetings already booked:** the timetable window tells you if a meeting still to come clashes with what you've just entered, which helps at the start of a semester.
- **In the calendar:** the new **Timetables** button shows when students are busy, for all of them or just one. It is off each time you open the app, so the calendar stays uncluttered. Busy times are never put in calendar files.

### Backup copy
- **Keep a copy somewhere else:** in Settings › Backup copy, choose a folder on another drive, a USB stick or a synced folder. Each save then also updates a copy of your data file there, just as encrypted and opened with the same password.
- **If the folder can't be reached:** your data still saves as usual. A message tells you, and **Saved** at the bottom of the sidebar shows a warning until the copy works again.
- **On each computer:** the folder is remembered on this computer only, so choose one on each computer you use.

### Fixes
- A meeting's **Google Calendar** and **Invite file** buttons could cover its title and "weekly" label. They now sit under the date and time.
- A viva or placement visit no longer makes the student's details panel wider. Their date and time now stack, one above the other.

### Notes
- Set the semester dates in Settings: clashes are only checked during teaching weeks.
- Existing data files open unchanged.
- If you use one data file on several computers, update Supervisor on all of them: an older version would lose the timetables when it saves.
